html:
Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum was the ruler of Dubai from 1958 to 1990 and the man who set it on the road from a creek-side trading town to a world city.

Dubai had little oil. Rashid borrowed to dredge the creek around 1960 so larger ships could enter, then built an airport, Port Rashid and the Jebel Ali port and free zone, finished in 1979. He bet that trade, not oil, would last.

With Zayed of Abu Dhabi he founded the UAE in 1971, and he served as its vice-president and prime minister. His sons, including Mohammed bin Rashid, carried on the plan, adding Emirates airline and the Burj Khalifa.
sum: Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum was the ruler of Dubai from 1958 to 1990 and the man who set it on the road from a creek-side trading town to a world city.
